subject: Innovex security questionnaire — roundtable scheduling and evidence inventory
messages:
From: Tom Harris <tom.harris@innovex.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Innovex security questionnaire — initial scheduling

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. We're completing an internal review and would like to run a short roundtable to go through the SIG/CAIQ questions and confirm evidence owners. Is your team available next week for a 45-minute session? Preferable times for us: Tue 5/18 10:00–11:00 ET or Wed 5/19 14:00–15:00 ET.

Attached is our trimmed questionnaire (Innovex_SIG_questions_v2.xlsx) — we've highlighted ~30 questions where we need clarification and a handful of evidence requests (logging, key management, data residency).

Main asks:
- Confirm what artifacts you can provide (SOC2 scope, config screenshots, KV/cache logs).
- Clarify KMS/HSM usage and key rotation cadence.
- Discuss retention and export options for customer logs.

If those times don't work, propose alternatives and we'll adjust.

Regards,
Tom Harris
Head of Security Programs
Innovex Systems

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Tom — thanks for sending this over and for the highlights, that's helpful. We can do Tue 5/18 10:00 ET. I'll set up a 45-minute slot and share an agenda.

Pre-call notes:
- We'll have Ethan Park (platform security) and Naomi Feldman (prod ops) join to cover logs/retention and runtime controls.
- Karthik Iyer (compliance) will own the CAIQ mapping and evidence deliverables.

Attached I'll drop a short primer (redwood-sig-overview.pdf) and a KMS diagram (redwood-kms-diagram.png). For the call, can you confirm whether Innovex needs key material exportability details (we do not export key material from Redwood-managed KMS by default)?

Action items before the call:
- Tom: flag any high-priority questions in the sheet so we can focus the agenda (if not, we'll triage the highlighted ones).
- Marissa: prepare SOC2 scope summary and a short list of artifacts we can produce within 3 business days.
- Karthik: prepare CAIQ mapping template for the session.

I'll send the calendar invite in a minute.

Best,
